list.title: Online Grievance Hearing
list.lead: The Hon'ble Minister's Office announces Online Grievance Hearings in advance. Register your grievance during the open window for the session you wish to attend. Registration follows the same process as WhatsApp grievance registration.
list.howItWorksLead: Three steps from registration to hearing updates on WhatsApp.
list.step1Text: Pick an open Online Grievance Hearing below. Each session has its own registration window and hearing date.
list.step2Text: Complete the same details as WhatsApp registration - personal information, department, grievance description, and optional documents.
list.step3Text: Save your reference ID. Confirmation, selection, and Google Meet details are sent to your registered WhatsApp number.
list.selectHearing: Select a hearing and register before the closing date shown on each card.
list.emptyBody: There are no Online Grievance Hearings accepting registration at this time. Please check announcements on the Minister's official channels and return here when a new session is announced.
list.footerBefore: By registering, you agree to the
list.footerAfter: . All hearing updates are sent to the WhatsApp number you provide during registration.

success.title: Thank you for registering
success.lead: Your grievance has been submitted for the Online Grievance Hearing. Please save the reference number below for future tracking.
success.refHint: Screenshot or note this number. You will need it for any follow-up.
success.downloadHint: Save this report for your records.
success.pdfFailed: Could not download PDF. Please try again.
success.whatIsBody: This is your unique grievance ID in the Jana Samadhan portal. It is created when your registration is saved and stays the same for this grievance through screening, hearing, and department follow-up.
success.howTitle: How it helps you track your grievance
success.how1: Quote this ID when you contact the helpline or Minister's Office.
success.how2: Use it to identify your case in WhatsApp messages from the portal.
success.how3: Keep it safe so you can check status or share details if asked again.
success.next1Body: A confirmation message with your reference ID and hearing date ({when}) is sent to your registered WhatsApp number in your preferred language.
success.next2Body: PS / OSD officials screen all registrations for this hearing. Not every grievance may be shortlisted for the live hearing.
success.next3Body: You will receive a WhatsApp message with your serial number, hearing date and time, and the Google Meet link. Please join about 15 minutes before your turn.
success.next4Body: Your grievance remains registered in the system. You may be informed through WhatsApp if it is not shortlisted for this hearing session.
success.resolveTitle: How your grievance will be resolved
success.resolve1: During the Online Grievance Hearing, the Hon'ble Minister hears approved cases in serial order on Google Meet.
success.resolve2: Remarks and directions are recorded and routed to the concerned department for action.
success.resolve3: Further updates on progress may be shared with you on WhatsApp as the case moves forward.
success.footer: All notifications are sent to the WhatsApp mobile number you provided. No further action is required right now unless you receive a message asking for more information.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions - Online Grievance Hearing
terms.subtitle: Government of Odisha · Jana Samadhan Grievance Management Portal
terms.s1Body: By registering for an Online Grievance Hearing, you confirm that all information submitted (personal details, grievance description, and attachments) is true and accurate to the best of your knowledge. False or misleading information may lead to rejection of your registration or action under applicable law.
terms.s2Body: Registration does not guarantee selection for the live hearing. Registrations are reviewed by the Minister's Office (PS / OSD). Only approved grievances are assigned a serial number and invited to join the hearing via Google Meet.
terms.s3Body: Updates-including registration confirmation, selection, serial number, and Google Meet link-are sent to the WhatsApp mobile number you provide, in your chosen language. You are responsible for ensuring the number is correct and active.
terms.s4Body: Selected citizens must join the Google Meet session at the scheduled time, preferably 15 minutes before their serial number is called. Disruptive, abusive, or irrelevant conduct may result in removal from the session without further hearing.
terms.s5Body: Uploaded photos, videos, or documents must relate to your grievance and must not contain unlawful, offensive, or confidential third-party material. Maximum file limits apply as stated on the registration form.
terms.s6Body: Your data is used solely for grievance redressal under the Jana Samadhan programme, including routing to the concerned department and maintaining an audit trail. Data is handled in accordance with applicable government data protection guidelines.
terms.s7Body: Directions given during the hearing are recorded and forwarded to the relevant department for action. Time frames for resolution depend on the nature of the grievance and departmental process. The portal will communicate material updates via WhatsApp where applicable.
terms.closeHint: You may close this page and return to your registration form to continue.
